visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male editor wearing headphones sits at a production desk, focused on a professional monitor showing a scene of a woman in a raft. The setting is outdoors under a blue tent near lush green foliage. (2) Rapid montage cuts showing a yellow inflatable raft tossing in water, a large CGI T-Rex roaring on a riverbank, and people appearing to scream in terror. (3) A woman in a black bucket hat and utility vest stands on a wooden pier by a wide river, speaking animatedly to the camera with green mangrove-like trees in the background. (4) Behind-the-scenes footage reveals a film crew on a boat using a gimbal camera to film actors in a yellow raft; crew members are partially submerged in the water guiding the vessel. (5) Close-up shots of several women reacting with wide-eyed shock, followed by genuine laughter and clapping as they watch playback on a screen. (6) Various shots of the cast and crew on the riverbank interacting; a woman in a brown ruffled top acts out a terrified expression while crew members laugh. (7) A sequence showing a woman screaming intensely into the camera for a take, then immediately breaking character to laugh as variety-style captions appear on screen. (8) Footage of the woman in the brown dress sitting inside a wooden boat cabin, gesturing as she speaks calmly in an interview-style setup. (9) A high-action cinematic trailer sequence follows, featuring the raft being chased by a dinosaur, underwater shots of bubbles, and dramatic splashing. (10) The screen transitions to black with the official 'Jurassic World Rebirth' logo, followed by a theatrical billing block and release date text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Background chatter and soft ambient nature sounds are punctuated by bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM. (2) A massive, low-frequency T-Rex roar shakes the soundscape, followed by high-energy orchestral brass and the sound of rushing water. (3) Professional English narration begins at a steady, clear pace, explaining the filming process over light, upbeat synth pulses. (4) Frequent bursts of collective female laughter and high-pitched vocal reactions coincide with multiple digital UI 'whoosh' sound effects. (5) Sound of a person screaming in a high-pitched, terrified tone for several seconds, which is abruptly cut off by a 'pop' sound effect and cheering. (6) Audio shifts to a more intimate field recording style with the hum of a boat motor and gentle splashes as a woman speaks in a conversational, calm Mandarin tone. (7) Epic orchestral strings and pounding cinematic percussion swell to a crescendo, accompanying high-stakes action sounds like heavy impacts and splashing. (8) A final deep, resonating sub-bass boom signals the end of the promotional segment, trailing off into a sustained string note.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional behind-the-scenes vlog for the film 'Jurassic World Rebirth'. It combines the excitement of visiting a real movie set in Thailand with lighthearted interactions between a creator and the crew, ultimately aiming to build anticipation for the movie's summer theatrical release.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly features the filming process, trailer clips, and the final title card for the movie 'Jurassic World Rebirth'.
